success.weighting: Each workflow version has total weight 1 within the success endpoint

inference.confidence_interval: pointwise 95%, t(G-1); not simultaneous FDR intervals
inference.multiple_testing: BH across identifiable smell coefficients only; q<0.05
inference.numerical_underflow: Underflowed p values are conservatively bounded above by numpy.finfo(float).tiny

success.interpretation: Adjusted linear associations, not causal effects. Coefficients are probability differences, not odds ratios.
limitations: Linear additive probability specification; predictions are not clipped.
Conventional cluster inference may be fragile for smells present in few repositories; report exposure cluster counts.
